quests.title: “Guys, I swear I have a girlfriend!”
quests.description: This quest is not recommended for normal quest takers. This quest is quite simple but also very taxing on the mind. Step one: Claim you have a girlfriend to your friends, then let that simmer for a bit until people start asking, “Who and where is she? How do you know her?” That kind of jazz. The problem is, you can’t show what they look like or their social media, because they don’t exist. There is no real second step, because you just have to BS it until too many people start guessing. Make up as many random facts as possible to make it believable, but also add some wrong facts so the smarter people start realizing something’s wrong. When someone asks you about it, deny it with all your will. Adamantly deny everyone who tries to dig into the lie until the very end, where you reveal this quest to one or two people. This is difficult to do because it’s a lie people will try and use the internet to debunk. If you are forced to give a name, make up something simple. WARNING: THIS IS NOT RECOMMENDED, FOR IT MAY RUIN MANY FRIENDSHIPS. ONLY DO THIS IF YOU REALLY, REALLY ARE BORED. THIS IS YOUR LAST WARNING.

quests.description: Make an original song on your own (can be with a friend, but I recommend doing it by yourself). It must be YOU; don't be doing no ChatGPT or Gemini, it's not fun that way. It can be any genre of music, as long as you like it. Bonus points if you publish it.

quests.title: Make new friends
quests.description: Get at least 3 random people to go bowling with you.

quests.title: Cleaning Your Room
quests.description: Clean your room. Vacuum, new bedsheets, clean workspace, etc.

quests.title: Painting Stones and Then Hiding Them in the Mountains
quests.description: Collect smooth stones, clean and dry them. Paint simple designs with acrylics or paint pens, and let them dry. Optionally, seal them. Then, hide the stones in the mountains for others to find and enjoy.

quests.title: Field
quests.description: Walk through a random field until you get somewhere interesting or get lost.

quests.title: Cosplay at a con
quests.description: Get a friend and pick character you want dress up like you dont have to make if big and fancy or expensive just have fun with it

quests.title: Shave Your Head Completely Smooth
quests.description: It's not rocket science? Bonus: 1,500 XP is you wax your eyebrows

quests.title: Successfully aqquire a j*b!
quests.description: Apply for a j*b. Get an interview. Get empl*yed. Good luck! This crazy hard in the current j*b market bruh

quests.title: Mission: possible
quests.description: Find a tall building and press all the buttons in the elevator and if someone gets on you have to get off a the floor they got on and explore

quests.title: The embarrassment
quests.description: Style a black plastic bag into clothes and wear them out in public

quests.title: Skinny dipping
quests.description: ASK a random person to go skinny dipping

quests.title: Are you real?
quests.description: Travel and finally meet your online gaming buddy. (Plan ahead. Get your own accommodations)

quests.title: Don't care what they think
quests.description: Go do 10 push-ups in public and walk off casually.

quests.title: The Great Trolley Run
quests.description: Take a shopping cart/trolley from one store and return it at the same store, but in a different suburb.

quests.title: Halfway There
quests.description: Climb halfway up a random tree, building, or anything climbable. When you get there, scream like King Kong with a few paper airplanes.

quests.title: Siege
quests.description: BUILD A TREBUCHET (that shoots water balloons)

quests.title: Learn Kung Fu
quests.description: Go to China. Learn Kung Fu and compete in a tournament. (+1000 XP if you win)

quests.title: Watch at Sunset or Sunrise
quests.description: You have to watch the sunset or sunrise (depending on the time).

quests.title: SUBMIT A SIDEQUEST
quests.description: Make a sidequest. Simple as that. Submit a sidequest.

quests.title: Imposter
quests.description: Attend a book club meeting with complete strangers without having read the book at all. If you are found out, the quest fails. You can attempt to convince them that you have, but if you really get caught, admit defeat.

quests.title: Talking
quests.description: Have a chat with a stranger near your house.

quests.title: Farmer
quests.description: Go to a nearby farm or other place with animals. And name all the animals with names from your class.

quests.title: Local Legend
quests.description: Ask a stranger for their best obscure recommendation in the area, then go check it out once you have a chance.

quests.title: Build
quests.description: Build something new for your house or room. It could be anything from a bed to a candle, but it has to be completely from scratch.

quests.title: Skater
quests.description: Buy a skateboard and learn to ride. Bonus points if you do it with a buddy.

quests.title: Paint a Masterpiece
quests.description: Go and grab some paint and a canvas, and paint.

quests.title: HOLY SPOT
quests.description: Find a majestic spot and get an awesome photo.

quests.title: Escape Room
quests.description: Go to a scary escape room or a haunted house with your friends and try to beat it.

quests.title: Climb up
quests.description: Climb 2m up on a tree or a wall. Don’t fall.

quests.title: BUNGEE JUMPING
quests.description: Simple: go bungee jumping.

quests.title: Make a Treasure Hunt
quests.description: Bury a treasure and hide a map to it in a public place.

quests.title: Recreating Memes
quests.description: Go recreate viral memes from the internet with your friends.

quests.title: When life gives you lemons
quests.description: Relive your childhood by setting up a lemonade stand at the end of your road and give lemonade to your neighbors (or sell it).

quests.title: Random Item
quests.description: You and your friends bring a random item to school or work. It can be anything from an iron to a lock.

quests.title: Anonymous Letter
quests.description: Send someone a sweet anonymous letter.

quests.title: Name Your City/Village
quests.description: Skip the boring names! Instead, you should give places around your city new names. Like the house beside you, you can name after your favorite character's house, or why not name your local energy tower after the Eiffel Tower!

quests.title: “Finish” Minecraft (with a friend)
quests.description: Defeat the Ender Dragon, make a beacon with diamonds, get full netherite armor/tools, get elytra, and make a lovely home. Most of all, do it with a friend.

quests.title: Picasso
quests.description: Recreate a famous work of art in a completely different style.

quests.title: I Love You, Mom
quests.description: Buy or pick flowers for your mom. You don't need a reason to do this.

quests.title: Pizza
quests.description: Get a pizza with your friends and eat at the restaurant.

quests.title: Random Runner
quests.description: Get a stranger to join you for a run and see who is faster.

quests.title: No Comprendo Inglés
quests.description: Go to your nearest gas station and pretend you don't speak English when you're checking out.

quests.title: Perfect Egg
quests.description: Cook a sunny-side-up egg without breaking the yolk or burning the white.

quests.title: Visit your local thrift store!
quests.description: Not just Goodwill or something. Like one that's owned by an old couple or something.

quests.title: Record a cover of a song
quests.description: Doesn’t matter if it’s just vocals or you actually making a cover; just send a video of it and you pass.

quests.title: King of the Hill
quests.description: Make your own flag (with a pole, it must be at least A4-sized) and take a selfie on top of a hill in your area with the flag standing.

quests.title: Get a Job
quests.description: Go up to random places and ask for a job. To complete, provide proof of you going up and asking for a job, them saying yes, then photos of the employment paperwork. All necessary documents must be legally binding.

quests.title: Restart your brain
quests.description: Stare at a wall for 10 minutes.

quests.title: Befriend a Crow
quests.description: Start feeding a crow or crows until they bring you a gift in return.

quests.title: The Local Tourist
quests.description: You have to spend a day as a tourist in your own city, asking for directions and exploring it.

quests.title: Origami
quests.description: Make an origami swan

quests.title: New outfit
quests.description: Put on some unusual clothes and go out on the town in them.

quests.title: Best Trader in Town
quests.description: Grab a pencil from home. Go around your city and ask people to trade it for something. Do so until you get an item that you set as a goal from the start of the quest.

quests.title: Start Chemistry Chapter 1
quests.description: Start the chapter today. Watch a video on it and begin making notes.

quests.title: Wheelie Hard Escape
quests.description: You must go to Walmart or any big store with bikes, take one down, and ride it around the store, evading all workers/security for 6.5 minutes nonstop.

quests.title: Sketch Time
quests.description: Using pen and paper, draw yourself from memory. Make sure to use a pen so you can't erase mistakes.

quests.title: King of the Hill
quests.description: Go for a walk and climb the tallest hill in your local area.

quests.title: Wherever AI Takes Me
quests.description: Open any type of AI (ChatGPT, Siri, Gemini, etc.) and just go in the middle of nowhere and let it choose to turn left or right.

quests.title: Perfect Sourdough
quests.description: Make the perfect sourdough from scratch. You need to make your own starter as well! Then get it judged on the Reddit sourdough page, and if you get at least an 8/10, you can complete this quest.

quests.title: Best 1h of your life
quests.description: Just do nothing for 1h straight — no electronics or any kind of activity. Just sit around and enjoy doing nothing.

quests.title: Dance Class
quests.description: Go to the nearest dance studio and join them for one class and learn at least one dance. +200 XP if it's a partner dance with your friend.

quests.title: Ho-bro
quests.description: Befriend a homeless dude.

quests.title: BEDAZZLING
quests.description: Bedazzle anything for at least an hour. It's an anti-stressing activity, and you can find the material pretty much everywhere.

quests.title: Go Outside
quests.description: Go outside and ask Siri every single time there are multiple paths you can take if you should go left or right.

quests.title: Zufallszugfahrt
quests.description: Nimm einen Würfel und wähle das Gleis, wohin du fährst. Dann wirf den Würfel erneut und bestimme, wie viele Stationen du im Zug fährst. Mach das zehnmal und nimm von jedem Ort ein Souvenir mit. Bonus: Mach ein Selfie mit einer fremden Person.

quests.title: Ghostbusters
quests.description: "Ring the doorbell of a house where you don't know the residents. Bring a vacuum cleaner, dress up as a Ghostbuster, and try to convincingly explain to the occupant that they have ghosts and you're there to catch them. You must not mention anything about the quest."

quests.title: Music Guy/Gal
quests.description: Make a song in a music-making software. Use any instruments you like, but cap it at 5. (Trust me, you'll hate doing more than 5.) Just create.

quests.title: Friend Finder
quests.description: Start up a conversation with a rando at a cafe (bonus 5000 XP if you guys become friends).

quests.title: Ironman
quests.description: Enter and complete an official Ironman triathlon.

quests.title: Fitness Guru
quests.description: Complete the Bring Sally Up challenge (push-ups).

quests.title: Unique Uber Eats
quests.description: Sign up for Uber Eats or any food delivery app and deliver someone's food with the most unique mode of transport (e.g., a unicycle).

quests.title: Abstract Tree
quests.description: Pick up a leaf in each hand and pretend to be a tree standing on the sidewalk for at least 20 minutes.

quests.title: Darkest Night
quests.description: Find a stretch of woods where you can easily hide from one another (multiplayer quest). The objective of this game is to silently eliminate all others without being detected. To do this, sneak up behind someone and "assassinate" them. Takedowns are allowed, and the only rule is: don't do anything stupid, such as climbing super high trees (small trees are fine).

quests.title: The Illusion of Belonging
quests.description: Blend into a corporate environment so naturally that you’re treated like you belong. Until the illusion breaks.

quests.title: Clap Push-ups
quests.description: Do as many push-ups as you can in one minute. Wait a couple of minutes and try one more time. Try to do more push-ups the second time.

quests.title: Creature
quests.description: Draw your own new creature on white paper.

quests.title: Mastering Paintball
quests.description: Learn professional paintball technique at a workshop and compete with friends in a team!

quests.title: Crazy Cupcakes
quests.description: Get a team of people together and bake at least 3 dozen cupcakes and sell all of them in the same day.

quests.title: Flower Falls
quests.description: Go on a walk and collect flowers and make a mini bouquet with at least 5 different types of flowers.

quests.title: Mix and Magic.
quests.description: Start an art business; make at least 10 pieces of art; advertise, sell, and make at least double the invested amount, all in 1 month. Get friends to tag along as well.

quests.title: No Huzz Talk
quests.description: No talking about the huzz for a whole day.

quests.title: International Hike
quests.description: Go to your closest airport, buy the cheapest flight outside your country. When you get there, convince a stranger to hike the tallest mountain in the zone with you.

quests.title: Throwback Tuesday?
quests.description: Find an old picture of you and a friend/family member and recreate it.

quests.title: Scary movie
quests.description: Convince a stranger to watch a scary movie with you at the theater.

quests.title: Show up to your friend's house
quests.description: The game plan is: show up to your friend's house without them knowing. Knock on the door, walk past whoever's there, go to the kitchen, and grab yourself a snack. Then leave, don't say a word, and go back home.

quests.title: Participate in a bird monitoring program
quests.description: Participate in a citizen-science or hobby ornithologist bird monitoring program

quests.title: Learn to do a handstand
quests.description: You must be able to hold a handstand on your own (no walls, etc.) for at least 10 seconds.

quests.title: (In)Formal Dance Party
quests.description: Dance the popular Greek dance “Sirtaki” with any professor of yours.

quests.title: Midnight Adventure
quests.description: I am with 4 friends, and we want to go on a side quest.

quests.title: Mirror King
quests.description: Take one single photo where you appear five or more times, but only through reflection.

quests.title: Time to learn!
quests.description: Learn a new skill. Learn it well enough to be able to get praise from at least two people. It can be cooking, music, photography, etc. Anything you can put your mind to! (Bonus points if you make it a way to earn money)

quests.title: Stranger Danger Dog Days
quests.description: Find someone near you that owns a dog. Make note of their address. One day, having never met them before, go ask if you can take their dog to play at a nearby park. Take the dog and spend the afternoon playing with him/her.

quests.title: Boogie Down
quests.description: Go to a highly populated area and do the Macarena.

quests.title: Trading
quests.description: Trade a random item you own for something that belongs to a stranger.

quests.title: PowerPoint Night
quests.description: Try and get a group of friends to make silly PowerPoints, and get together to present them!

quests.title: Midnight Gas Station Run
quests.description: Go to the gas station and buy yourself something nice, because you deserve it, bro. Bonus XP if you get a Monster.

quests.title: Longest Shopping List
quests.description: Make a shopping list. Choose a type of local supermarket. Then visit all of that type of market and buy one item from your shopping list until the list is completed or you have visited all markets within a 50-kilometer radius. Bonus points if you don't use any transportation (bicycle, bus, car, etc.).

quests.title: Custom Board Game
quests.description: Create with your friends a board game that doesn't exist, or realize a custom version of a game you like.

quests.title: Where the f*ck are we?
quests.description: Leave at midnight with between 1 and 3 friends for a trip with no set route or destination using public transportation (bus, subway, etc.), and only return the next day.

quests.title: Act Like an NPC
quests.description: When you're out with friends/alone, act like video game NPCs in public (repeat phrases, give “quests” to strangers like, “Hi, I need you to find me a blue car,” and just repeat until they find something).

quests.title: TISSUE GIFT
quests.description: Make a tissue painting and gift it to a stranger.

quests.title: Rain Enthusiast
quests.description: The next time it rains, just go outside and walk around your neighborhood with your AirPods in. Also, wear a hoodie; they might get wet.

quests.title: Push-Ups
quests.description: Do 100 push-ups. Must get all on video.

quests.title: Find something
quests.description: Venture out into your hometown, city, or woods and don’t go home until you find something worth taking. It could be a lost key, a cool button, a free sticker from a store, or even a piece of garbage that looks cool. Do this with friends for an added adventure bonus!

quests.title: Mesh Masks Undercover
quests.description: Go to some place with mesh masks of celebrities, preferably where you will see a bunch of people you know. Don't tell them it's you.

quests.title: Bring bikes into a mall and ride them
quests.description: Just bring your bike, try to sneak it into the mall, and start riding.

quests.title: Go on a walk and say hello to everyone you pass
quests.description: Go on a long, nice walk through a town, city, forest, or anything, and say hello to anyone you pass.

quests.title: Give a random person a hug
quests.description: Try to meet someone new in a day and work up the courage to hug them. Try to make them happy!

quests.title: Cheapest Item
quests.description: You and your friend/friends go to a store and try to find the cheapest item. After 5 minutes, the person with the most expensive item has to pay for everybody else's items.

quests.title: The World Record Holder
quests.description: Go to speedrun.com and get any world record on any game (the game/speedrun popularity doesn't matter).

quests.title: FLY A KITE
quests.description: Go to Walmart and buy a kite that you fancy. Go to the nearest park and fly a kite by yourself.

quests.title: Ultimate Midnight Snack
quests.description: Go out and drive with your mate in the middle of the night to an open pizza place, eat the food, and go hang around. All in the middle of the night.

quests.title: Fishing
quests.description: Go fishing and catch a fish.

quests.title: Crosswalk Help
quests.description: Help someone cross the road.

quests.title: Go for a Swim
quests.description: Go swimming. You can do that in a pool, sea, river, etc.

quests.title: Handstands
quests.description: You had to learn to do a handstand in 4 hours. It challenges you on how flexible you are.

quests.title: Sorry, My Friend Is Deaf
quests.description: Go to a crowded area with your friend and try to get a girl for your buddy by saying that he is deaf, while communicating with him with sign language (doesn't need to be real sign language, just gibberish with your hands). The objective is getting as many Instagrams as possible.

quests.title: Hydrate Yourself
quests.description: Drink a glass of water. You really need it.

quests.title: Adopt a Cat
quests.description: Adopt a cat and upload the adoption papers with the date on them. Bonus 500 XP if it is orange.

quests.title: Ghost in the Machine
quests.description: Find a glitch in your city: a hidden alley, a door to nowhere, or a weird architectural error. Take a photo and describe what "secret purpose" this glitch serves.

quests.title: Better Than The NY Times!
quests.description: Interview random people and ask them completely random questions that make no sense. (Bonus points if recorded and posted.)

quests.title: Time flies
quests.description: Make a time capsule with your friends and bury it somewhere meaningful.

quests.title: A furry friend(s)
quests.description: Go outside and pet 6 dogs.

quests.title: Please, not KFC!
quests.description: Pull up to any drive-thru dressed as a chicken and order using a rubber chicken between sentences.

quests.title: A scientist
quests.description: Study at least 20 minutes! So hard, right?

quests.title: Traveling Pass
quests.description: You and your friend drive in a bus for 1 hour and explore the spot where it ends.

quests.title: Mystery Chef
quests.description: Gather a group of 4 to 7 friends. Each person should bring an ingredient without knowing what the others will bring, and from that, create a dish together.

quests.title: Marty McFly
quests.description: Go up to a random stranger, act panicked, and ask what year it is. If they answer, walk 1 or 2 meters away and say, loud enough that they can hear, "By God, I've done it!"

quests.title: Stone Age
quests.description: 5 hours without a phone!

quests.title: The Wandering Cowboy
quests.description: Go out wearing a cowboy hat and take a photo with a stranger.

quests.title: DRAWING QUEST
quests.description: Draw a random person while following him/her and give the drawing to them. You can also just draw them as a stickman, based on your skills.

quests.title: Submit a Quest and Get 50 Upvotes
quests.description: Submit a quest and get 50 upvotes. It can be anything, but it's better if it's outside.

quests.title: "Everyone Knows This Song"
quests.description: Go and listen to an entire album by an artist you have never heard of before. Rate the songs from 1-10 and write a detailed review of the album. Post it on the artist's subreddit and reply to at least one comment there.

quests.title: Landscape
quests.description: Go into a park and draw the nature surrounding you.

quests.title: Stranger
quests.description: Draw a Stranger and ask them to pose.

quests.title: New book
quests.description: Go to a bookstore and pick out an interesting book. Find out the pacing you need to read it within 1-2 months, and read that number of pages per day. Once you finish, write an email to the author talking about the aspects of the book you enjoyed.

quests.title: Maggot!
quests.description: Drop down and give me 30 push-ups!

quests.title: WALK. WALK. WALK!
quests.description: Walk for an entire day and map your route.

quests.title: Fluffy!
quests.description: Pet a random cat in the street. If you take him home, there is 200 bonus XP.

quests.title: Little Experiment
quests.description: Go around your city and find interesting objects, then take photos of them. Go home and redraw the thing you like the most, turning it into a picture. Add details, a background, everything! Lastly, write a story about this object; make one up. This will help you let your emotions out in many ways.

quests.title: It's Been Too Long!
quests.description: Check up on a friend you haven't talked to in a long time and talk to them for at least 10 minutes.

quests.title: THE GODFATHER
quests.description: Dress up like an Italian mafia with two of your friends and walk around town.

quests.title: The Fish Experience
quests.description: Jump into a lake, river, or ocean with clothes on. BONUS: Tell people you know that you accidentally fell in.

quests.title: Clean Up Your Room
quests.description: Clean your room, or tidy it up.

quests.title: Try to be shy
quests.description: Don't talk or say any word to strangers for an entire day.

quests.title: CROSSWORD TIME!
quests.description: Get yourself a crossword puzzle and complete it. Bonus if you get the crossword from an elderly person and compete in it with them.

quests.title: Eat with a Stranger
quests.description: Ask a random stranger you find if they want to go eat at a restaurant with you and eat a whole meal with them. (Bonus 2,000 XP if you pay for the entire meal.)

quests.title: Date, Bro
quests.description: Bring your best friend on a date where you hang out like a real date, hitting date criteria like banter, eye-gazing, a quirky twist, hand-holding, face-to-face dinner, and a kiss on the cheek, and either paying for the bill or splitting it. Then you must count your bro as someone you have dated for the rest of your life. Extreme questers will make it official for a day, then break up and have bro be officially an ex.

quests.title: Not-So-Grand Tour
quests.description: You and some friends buy poor-quality cars and tour your country/state for at least 5 days.

quests.title: Do 10 sketches
quests.description: Go do 10 sketches. I know you can do it, my fellow art student!

quests.title: Roadtrip
quests.description: Take at least two buses to a random place and just find a spot and eat. It can be a restaurant; it can be something you brought.

quests.title: Yeah, I'm a regular
quests.description: Choose a store/restaurant/bar near your house and start going there at least twice a week. Try to befriend the workers; ask about their day and tell them about yours. After the friendship is settled, your goal is to hang out with them outside of there. Invite them to a park or somewhere you guys talked about.

quests.title: Non-Dominant Hand
quests.description: Do everything with your non-dominant hand for the whole day, including writing, brushing teeth, using utensils, etc.

quests.title: Touch the grass
quests.description: Go outdoors/outside for some physical activity like walk/bike/hike and touch some grass.

quests.title: Be Smart
quests.description: Go and read 20 pages of a book.

quests.title: Birdlover
quests.description: Go out on a hike alone or with friends for the pure sake of taking bird pictures.

quests.title: Eat a Food in Its Namesake Place
quests.description: Tons of foods are named after places: hamburgers, frankfurters, and pilsners, to name a few. Even in the U.S., Boston Kreme, California Roll, Philly Cheesesteak, etc. To complete this challenge, you must eat a food in the geographic area from which it derives its name.

quests.title: Chug, Chug, Chug!
quests.description: Chug a whole water bottle.

quests.title: Take a Shower!!!
quests.description: Go in the shower and wash yourself.

quests.title: Game Inventors
quests.description: Make up a sport or a game with your friends.

quests.title: EARLY BIRD
quests.description: Wake up at 6 AM and go out for a walk or cycling.

quests.title: Tin Hat Army
quests.description: Get a group of friends and take turns presenting crazy conspiracy theories and why they are true.

quests.title: Album Lover
quests.description: Listen to a whole album that's new to you in one session.

quests.title: Tag Time
quests.description: Run up to a stranger, tag them while yelling "Tag, you're it!", and then repeat this until you get someone to tag you back.

quests.title: A New Friend
quests.description: Tame any bird to get it to land on your hand.

quests.title: Chocolate Meeting
quests.description: Offer a stranger who is alone a chocolate and get to know them.

quests.title: Cool Jeans
quests.description: Do some funny, small embroidery detail on your favorite jeans.

quests.title: The Cent Hunt
quests.description: Go up to people and ask them for a single cent.

quests.title: Go camping with friends
quests.description: Go camping with friends

quests.title: Practice drawing
quests.description: Practice drawing the same thing for 10 days and compare the drawings at the end.

quests.title: Learn a New Language
quests.description: Learn any language to the point you can understand it and talk fluently.

quests.title: Sunkissed in Every Park
quests.description: Go on a walk and visit at least 3-5 parks in your city (or a city you're visiting). You must choose a sunny day, and bonus points if you go with a friend or a date.

quests.title: Abandoned Building
quests.description: Go find a condemned building in your area. Then go explore the abandoned building and submit the weirdest and creepiest things you can find. Has to be with a friend to complete.

quests.title: Unknown Known Lands
quests.description: Go take a walk in your local area in a place you haven't been to or considered walking through before. Use that free will!

quests.title: Kindness Treasure Hunt
quests.description: Spread some positivity in your community! Your mission: perform 5 random acts of kindness in one day. Examples: leave a kind note for someone, compliment a stranger, help a neighbor, or donate unused items. Keep a small “treasure map” journal of your acts without naming people directly. The fun is in creatively finding ways to brighten other people’s days and seeing how kindness spreads. Bonus XP if you inspire a friend to do the same!

quests.title: Campfire
quests.description: We went campfiring, all the group, and that was the craziest thing I have ever done.

quests.title: Hairstylist
quests.description: Go to a mall with your friend and have a setup similar to a lemonade stand, except pretend you're a hairstylist. When someone wants to get their hair done, just pretend you know what you're doing.

quests.title: new life?
quests.description: Start a successful legal and ethical business.

quests.title: Will You Dare?
quests.description: Gather your group of friends (four or more). You will be the Game Maker. You give each person a two-part dare, each dare worth a certain number of points. Do the dare, send a pic to the Game Maker. Time's up at midnight. The next day, you meet up and add up your points. The person who has the most points wins. Good luck!

quests.title: Dog Walker
quests.description: Start a dog-walking business in your area and work for at least one day. (Maybe you won't want to stop!)

quests.title: Introduction
quests.description: Go around with a friend and introduce them however you want, and they have to play along.

quests.title: Rent A Friend
quests.description: You and your friends stand in the middle of a park and have a sign that says “rent us for a day.” Then, when the person rents you guys, you have to listen to them all day.

quests.title: Meet a New Friend
quests.description: Make friends with a stranger in person somewhere.

quests.title: Who Are You?
quests.description: Ignore one friend for one week with your friend group. If somebody talks to him like he knows him, you failed. You can't tell him why you ignored him after the week for another week. Good luck.

quests.title: The Midnight Hike
quests.description: Go to a mountain in the evening, then sleep there with a tent and wake up in the middle of the night to reach the top to see the sunrise.

quests.title: Pierce yourself!!
quests.description: Get actual equipment, plz! But, pierce yourself, for example, a nose piercing or your lip!

quests.title: Fun Twist
quests.description: Walk up to a stranger and, using the quest generator, give them a quest instead of doing it yourself.

quests.title: Double the Fun
quests.description: Walk up to a group of strangers with your current friend group, forging both groups into a bigger one.

quests.title: Join a D&D game
quests.description: Go to a local store that hosts this and play a round (or more) with strangers or friends.

quests.title: You can do it
quests.description: Get a girlfriend/boyfriend and hold hands with him/her.

quests.title: Climbing higher
quests.description: Go climb a multi-pitch climbing route with a friend. It can be any grade you want, but you must complete it without falling.

quests.title: 67 Tour
quests.description: You and your friend go around the city streets, supermarkets, malls, etc., and find the numbers 6 and 7 just for fun!

quests.title: Count to 100
quests.description: Not much challenging.

quests.title: Walking and Golfing
quests.description: Go for 18 holes, no cart, just you, the golf bag, and the course.

quests.title: Shopper from Everywhere
quests.description: Go to a grocery store and ask where to find a Fanta in accent 1 (e.g., Australian). Then, buy something completely different, asking “How much is this?” in accent 2 (e.g., Indian). Then, say thank you or bye in accent 3. Saying “Grazie” also works. Bonus points if the vendor doesn't clock it.

quests.title: Cycling to Random Places
quests.description: You and your friend will take your cycle or any other vehicle and go to random places that you don't know. It can be in your own city, or it can be far from your city.

quests.title: Meditation
quests.description: Meditate for half an hour without any distraction.

quests.title: Exams are coming
quests.description: Turn off your mobile and go for a walk with your friends, a long walk, a really, really long walk.

quests.title: Become a Monkey
quests.description: Climb a tree and eat a banana. Bonus 500 XP if you dress like a monkey.

quests.title: Explore the Unexplorable
quests.description: You need to go to either a famous haunted house or explore an abandoned area/location/house, whatever. The evidence needs to contain a picture of you or your friends posing with a wall or pillar in that location.

quests.title: Card Craze
quests.description: Buy a trading card pack and pull something worth over 2 dollars.

quests.title: Really Creative
quests.description: Play Minecraft for 8 hours non-stop.

quests.title: Guitar
quests.description: Pick up the guitar in the corner of your room, learn three chords, and make your own song out of that.

quests.title: Draw Your Neighbor's Face
quests.description: Paint your neighbor's face and leave it in their mailbox.

quests.title: Talking to Random People About Life
quests.description: Go to some random place, like a gas station, and start talking with some older guy about life.

quests.title: The one with the ghost
quests.description: Go to a random abandoned place and do a ghost investigation with a friend.

quests.title: Learn how to do a handstand
quests.description: Just learn how to stand on your hands for a minimum of 5 seconds in one day.

quests.title: Midnight Adventure
quests.description: Give us some crazy quests in which my friend and I can enjoy the dares or quests.

quests.title: Stop-Motion Film
quests.description: Create a stop-motion film. It doesn't matter if it's LEGO, cars, or even just paper. There are apps for that.

quests.title: Volunteer!
quests.description: Volunteer at your local food bank, shelter, or just hand things out to people for free.

quests.title: Sprite Challenge
quests.description: Buy a two-liter of Sprite and go up to a stranger and ask if they'll do the Sprite challenge with you, and then proceed to do the challenge. The first to burp has to do the same with another stranger.

quests.title: Crazy Thing
quests.description: Go skydiving in Europa.

quests.title: Spaghetti Time Traveler
quests.description: Ask someone what year it is in public, then start freaking out about how the Spaghetti Lord teleported you to the wrong year.

quests.title: Call! Trust me!
quests.description: Call someone close to you. Doesn't need to have a goal. Talk about your day, ask them how theirs was. Just talk; you always will get into a situation!

quests.title: Ice to the Cream
quests.description: Go to an ice cream shop and bring your own old, empty ice cream tub and ask them to fill it with ice cream.

quests.title: Free work
quests.description: Go to your local supermarket and offer yourself to work for a day.

quests.title: Music box
quests.description: Go to a store that has speakers and play music really loud.

quests.title: Chaotic Racing
quests.description: Join a random rental karting session (with 8+ people) and win the race (1st place).

quests.title: Football
quests.description: Buy a football and play a whole football match in a random location with random people where you personally invite them to play. (The location must not be a football pitch, and you have to play 90 minutes straight with a 10-minute break between the two halves. Each half has 45 minutes.)

quests.title: Book a holiday to an extremely bad hotel.
quests.description: Stay at least 3 nights, try all the food, drinks, etc., and then leave an honest review. This will test your mental skills while you try not to throw up because of some moldy cheese left in the fridge.

quests.title: A bit tired
quests.description: Do a full triathlon.

quests.title: Homeless
quests.description: Donate to homeless people in your town. Bonus if you make it like you're an influencer.

quests.title: High Jump
quests.description: Jump off of something over 10 feet into water.

quests.title: So jolly!
quests.description: Convince your friends to throw a party for absolutely nothing. Fill up some balloons, grab some snacks, invite some friends over, play some games—on the preference, non-digital ones, but it's up to you—put your favorite songs on, just for the fun of it.

quests.title: Learn how to ride a unicycle
quests.description: Learn to ride a unicycle and improve your balance while trying something new. And you will be so frickin' awesome!

quests.title: The Wilderness Must Be Explored!
quests.description: Go for a hike and camp legally or "legally."

quests.title: Thrift an Outfit for Your Friends
quests.description: With a limit of $20, go to a thrift store and buy an outfit for your friend that they have to wear to school or another function.

quests.title: Find a Porsche
quests.description: Go anywhere in your city and find a Porsche.

quests.title: Do push-ups
quests.description: Do push-ups till you can't.

quests.title: World's Smallest Vacation
quests.description: Go to the smallest town in your state/province/region/etc. and be able to spend at least 3 hours there.

quests.title: Draw a FU#%ING DINOSAUR!
quests.description: Draw any dinosaur of your choosing, specifically with the combination of yellow, blue, green, and red crayons.

quests.title: Climb a Mountain
quests.description: Climb on top of a mountain.

quests.title: Colorful World
quests.description: Complete a coloring-by-number picture.

quests.title: Learn the Greek Alphabet
quests.description: alpha (α), beta (β), gamma (γ), delta (δ), epsilon (ε), zeta (ζ), eta (η), theta (θ), iota (ι), kappa (κ), lambda (λ), mu (μ), nu (ν), xi (ξ), omicron (ο), pi (π), rho (ρ), sigma (σ), tau (τ), upsilon (υ), phi (φ), chi (χ), psi (ψ), omega (ω)

quests.title: Sea Soul Quest
quests.description: Get your open water certification in scuba diving °‧ 𓆝 𓆟 𓆞 ·｡

quests.title: CapCut Final Boss
quests.description: Record a side quest adventure and edit it in CapCut. Sound effects, text, jokes—make it funny for you, in your humor.

quests.title: The Ethereal Email
quests.description: Send an email to five of your favorite brands and ask for promotional items. Tip: Sports teams count as well.

quests.title: Microbiota Queens
quests.description: Try to make your own kombucha!

quests.title: Alas, poor Yorick!
quests.description: Take part in a theater play. If you don't find any groups in university or in your city looking for someone, gather your friends and learn or create a short play together.

quests.title: One Chip, No Water
quests.description: Get your friends together and each buy a One Chip Challenge. The last to drink water or any liquid wins!

quests.title: 100 PULL-UPS
quests.description: COMPLETE 100 PULL-UPS.

quests.title: Maximum Pushups
quests.description: Do as many pushups as you can right now, no matter where you are.

quests.title: Support Your Local Sports Team
quests.description: Look for any sports games around you and go watch a game.

quests.title: Homework Time...
quests.description: Do the most urgent homework you least want to do right now.

quests.title: (NOT) FREE LABOR
quests.description: Go up to a stranger and get a one-day job. It could be anything as long as it takes more than two hours and you get paid.

quests.title: BE GRATEFUL
quests.description: Tell your friends that you love them.

quests.title: The Curse of the Education
quests.description: Do your freakin' homework (c'mon, don't be lazy).

quests.title: The Good Samaritan
quests.description: Go offer some food to a homeless person.

quests.title: SPEEDCUBING
quests.description: Learn how to solve a Rubik's Cube under a minute.

quests.title: No phone
quests.description: Don't use your phone for 2 hours.

quests.title: From the Future
quests.description: Go up to a random kid and tell him, and convince him, that you're him from the future.

quests.title: Slenderman or Somethin'
quests.description: Draw every Slenderman drawing (from the game) and put them on the trees in your local park.

quests.title: Ice Cream for a Stranger
quests.description: Buy an ice cream cone for a complete stranger.

quests.title: Hug Your Mum
quests.description: Go hug your mom; it will make her happy. Sorry if she is dead, so if you can't, do it with someone you love.

quests.title: Can you add a “free section”?
quests.description: I’ve noticed a lot of quests cost money, and I think it could be helpful if there was a way to search quests by cheap/free, mid-tier, and expensive.

quests.title: Find a DJUNGELSKOG Without Looking It Up
quests.description: Go to IKEA and find a DJUNGELSKOG within 25 minutes of entering the store.

quests.title: CONFESSIONS...
quests.description: Get a journal. Tie a string or something around it, then leave it on a park bench or some other public area. Write a note in it inviting others to write or draw (or write something like "Why did you do it?"). Come back at the end of the day (hopefully it's still there).

quests.title: Star Wars
quests.description: Watch the whole Star Wars series in one day.

quests.title: Like to Go Fast, Huh?
quests.description: Speedrun a video game of your choice. The time that you beat the game is the time you have to run without stopping. Imagine if you beat the game in one hour; that means you have to run without stopping for an hour! Have fun!

quests.title: Wear that fit, girl!
quests.description: This is your day to wear THE fit that you were always too shy or scared to wear. Go outside in that banger outfit of yours.

quests.title: Trashbagging
quests.description: Slide down a grassy hill during rainy weather.

quests.title: Outdoor Art
quests.description: Go outside and draw with chalk.

quests.title: Pokémon Journey!
quests.description: Take a picture of 3 different animals while on a walk. You must keep walking until you have taken a picture of all 3.

quests.title: Make a PowerPoint
quests.description: Make a PowerPoint on whatever topic you want, and present it. Bonus points if you post it.

quests.title: Mr. Calculator
quests.description: Get 3 hours of screen time on your phone's calculator app! Attach a photo or a screenshot for proof.

quests.title: Monkey Business
quests.description: Go into a random public area with a banana, climb a tree, and start eating the banana in the tree.

quests.title: Write a poem
quests.description: Write a poem about your favorite subject.

quests.title: Build a LEGO Set Blind
quests.description: Build a LEGO set with at least 200 pieces in under 45 minutes. Don't worry, you must do it with a friend.

quests.title: Lift 3
quests.description: Lift 3× your body weight.

quests.title: Game of Fate
quests.description: Go to your local game store/club and play a board game with strangers.

quests.title: Your Weight
quests.description: Lift your body weight.

quests.title: Win a Prize from a Claw Machine
quests.description: The claw machine can be anywhere and any size, but it must be reasonably recognizable as a claw machine.

quests.title: Boat Acquired
quests.description: You and a friend (optional) must build a raft that you can fit in from just wood, rope, and nails. You must then test it in a body of water.

quests.title: A Little Bit of Everyone
quests.description: Sit at a table with your friend(s) and everyone gets one same-size canvas each to paint on. Everyone draws until 5 minutes have passed, then they pass it to the person next to them. Repeat this until each canvas returns to its original owner, or upon completion. (Bonus if the timer decreases after every pass.)

quests.title: Pet that dog
quests.description: Find a dog and ask to pet it, and ask a genuine question to the owner.

quests.title: How did we get here?
quests.description: Find a place in your area where you have never been before and just enjoy it.

quests.title: Rediscover Your Music
quests.description: Shuffle a playlist you haven't listened to in a while and have a little boogie.

quests.title: Get Your Google Maps Account to Level 5
quests.description: Go onto Google Maps and grind photos, reviews, and videos of places until your profile reaches Level 5 Local Guide.

quests.title: Find out your max bicep curl
quests.description: Go to a gym and see how much weight you can bicep curl.

quests.title: Embarrass your friend in school.
quests.description: Barge into your friend’s class and invite him to play something ridiculous with you after school, like dolls or something.

quests.title: Teacher's Question
quests.description: Ask a teacher to elaborate on a topic way deeper than necessary. The conversation must last at least 10 min.

quests.title: Unscripted Social Interaction
quests.description: Find someone you don't know (it can be a classmate or someone you've met, but you have to be pretty much strangers) and try to hold a conversation with them for 5-10 minutes. :\

quests.title: Formal McDonald's
quests.description: With your friends, dress up in formal attire and go eat at a fast-food chain.

quests.title: The Band
quests.description: Start a band and play a gig or record an album.

quests.title: Blind Trip
quests.description: Choose a random destination from your map app, check the directions, try to memorize them, and get there on your own. During your trip, do not double-check the directions.

quests.title: PAT A CAT
quests.description: Pat a cat, any cat, just give it some love.

quests.title: "No, 'cause I am not a dirty knitter; I am a crocheter!"
quests.description: Learn how to crochet.

quests.title: Polyglot
quests.description: Learn 5 new words in 3 languages different from your native one.

quests.title: Make bracelets and give them to a random person in public
quests.description: You guys make bracelets and then give them to strangers.

quests.title: Yoga Class
quests.description: Go sign up for 1 yoga class!

quests.title: No Place Like Home
quests.description: Decorate your room in a way you never have before.

quests.title: Ask a Stranger to a Date <3
quests.description: Find someone you don't know and ask them to go on a date with you for at least 3 hours.

quests.title: Monkey
quests.description: Hang on a tree branch, building, or pull-up bar (whatever's available to you).

quests.title: The Hangover Night
quests.description: Experience a hangover night and take a lot of photos.

quests.title: Drawing of Yourself
quests.description: Try to draw yourself from memory.

quests.title: Movie Maker
quests.description: Make a short film. It doesn't need to be good, have people, or be landscape. It just needs to be a little video on something you like. DaVinci Resolve has a free version, but if not, you can use any video editing software. Just create.

quests.title: Doodles
quests.description: Draw a little doodle of something. Just create.

quests.title: Time Capsule!!
quests.description: Get a container and put things from the last couple of years in it! Then, if you want, you can bury it or just seal it and put it in the back of your closet! This can be a solo side quest, or you can do it with friends!

quests.title: Make a short film with friends!
quests.description: Make a short film! Even if it's on your phone! You can do it by yourself, but it would be more fun with friends! It has to be at least 10 minutes long! Have fun!

quests.title: Musically Inclined
quests.description: Learn a NEW song on a musical instrument.

quests.title: Fitness in Public!
quests.description: Get 3 strangers to do a physical activity with you, whether it's a 5-minute jog or 20 push-ups!

quests.title: Go to a Forest Near You and Keep on Walking Until You Can't (Not literally; be safe and within legal limits!)
quests.description: Find a decently sized forest near you, enter, and just keep walking. Find old structures, fascinating wildlife, and amazing views. It's a way to adventure, de-stress, get some fitness in your life, and just enjoy what is an everyday view!

quests.title: Shawn and Gus
quests.description: Go out into public with a friend and introduce each other to strangers any way you want. Ex: "This is my brother; he never learned how to speak."

quests.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
quests.description: Set up a series of challenges similar to the Jimmy Jab Games in Brooklyn Nine-Nine and get your friends to participate.

quests.title: Master of the Map
quests.description: Get 8 friends and go out and make a 100m² map of your entire city. The guy who draws the most accurate map wins a Monster drink from each one.

quests.title: Music Playlist!
quests.description: Make a fully new playlist on a music app you use and listen to it!

quests.title: Ask out your crush and don't get rejected
quests.description: Ask out your crush to go on a date with you and make sure they say yes!

quests.title: Start a Collection
quests.description: Start a collection of something you really enjoy. If you already have one, add something new to it. Example: dinosaurs, books, a fictional character.

quests.title: Invisible Kindness
quests.description: Leave a small positive note somewhere public (bench, café table, library book). No signature.

quests.title: Essay
quests.description: Write an essay about any scientific subject that interests you!

quests.title: Audition
quests.description: Audition for something. Could be singing, acting, dancing, modeling, etc. Just show up and do your best.

quests.title: Random Bus Ride
quests.description: Go on a random bus and ride for 15 minutes.

quests.title: Draw a Flower
quests.description: Go outside and take a walk with a friend to find a pretty flower and take a picture then go home and draw it with as much detail as possible

quests.title: Love is in the air!
quests.description: Open up to your crush. Who knows, maybe they feel the same?

quests.title: Listen to a Full Album
quests.description: Just lay down and listen to a full album by any artist you like. No secondary activities; just admire the music.

quests.title: Rejection Therapy
quests.description: Submit a piece of art/poetry to any literature/art magazine. They don't have to accept/approve your work; just have one submitted <:

quests.title: Phone Detox
quests.description: Do not use your phone for two days, or even more; it's up to you! Tips:

quests.title: Do other sidequests in the meantime.
quests.description: Do other sidequests in the meantime.

quests.title: Drain your phone's battery.
quests.description: Drain your phone's battery.

quests.title: Line Rider
quests.description: Go to your nearest major city and ride the entirety of a subway/tram line without looking at your phone. Enjoy the view and the bustle of the city.

quests.title: Sleep overnight in an abandoned building
quests.description: You just have to spend one night in the building. It could be any sort of building, as long as it’s abandoned, and you can bring as many people as you want.

quests.title: Exercise yourself
quests.description: Do 50 correct push-ups right now.

quests.title: Stargazing
quests.description: Go stargazing and take a nice picture of it.

quests.title: Go explore your surroundings
quests.description: Just go on a random walk in your city or town, but take routes you never took before, like an alley or a field.

quests.title: Foreigner and Translator
quests.description: Pick a friend. Go out and make this friend speak a "foreign language" in front of random people. Your task is to translate everything he says. However, the translation can be whatever you want. Whoever breaks character first loses.

quests.title: TikTok Conquered
quests.description: Ask a random person to film a TikTok with you and post it.

quests.title: Makeup
quests.description: Try a new makeup style.

quests.title: Picnic!
quests.description: Go on a picnic with a friend, no phones or electronics, though. Use a digi-cam for memories. And bring snacks!

quests.title: Time Traveler
quests.description: So, go talk to five people and ask them which year it is. When they say the year, freak out and scream, "SH*T! WE ARE LOST IN TIME!" Then run away as hard as you can while still freaking out.

quests.title: On fire
quests.description: Go around to your local fire stations and convince them to let you slide down the pole.

quests.title: Win a game of chess
quests.description: Simple: win a game of chess.

quests.title: Coffee Shop Language
quests.description: Go to a coffee shop, ask if they know German, and then order in your local language.

quests.title: Perform Origami
quests.description: Show your advanced paper origami skills (bridge, ninja star, birds, rocket, etc.).

quests.title: The Roles
quests.description: You and your friend go out and have conversations with strangers, BUT you can introduce your friend as whatever you want, and they have to go along with it. Your friend can do the same for you. Example: "This is my friend Johnny; he's deaf." Johnny needs to do some convincing sign language, because if either one of you gets caught or breaks, it’s over.

quests.title: Happy Thoughts
quests.description: Write 100 things that make you happy, that you love, or are grateful for (be specific and detailed). Don’t do anything else until you reach 100 and write it ON PAPER!

quests.title: The Stalker
quests.description: Go to a friend's house, take a photo outside their door, and send it to them with the text “Guess where I am.”

quests.title: Lake Finding
quests.description: Find a random lake or one you know and swim in it. (Be careful if trespassing.)

quests.title: Neighborhood Hotshot
quests.description: Make a random meal for a neighbor and deliver it to them personally. Make sure they're NOT allergic!

quests.title: Calist Arc
quests.description: Master the muscle-up

quests.title: Drift a car in a parking lot
quests.description: Doesn’t have to be your car, you can use a car share! Wait till there’s fresh snow, find a big big empty parking lot where there is nothing you can hit, and do some donuts. Recommended to play Tokyo Drift to get in the spirit.

quests.title: Wrong bottle
quests.description: Consume water from a ketchup bottle in public.

quests.title: Giver
quests.description: Go through your room or anywhere in your house and find at least 10 items to donate. Could be clothes, decor, furniture, etc.

quests.title: THE ROCK
quests.description: Go get a really huge rock from somewhere and surprise your friend with it. Basically, just bring the rock to your friend without them knowing about it. It's funnier if they sleep and just wake up with a random huge rock in the middle of the room.

quests.title: What is this?!??
quests.description: Draw a person and ask someone if they've seen him/her.

quests.title: Drawing
quests.description: Create a drawing of your favorite animal.

quests.title: Rock climbing
quests.description: Go do some rock climbing, but it can’t be by a rock wall.

quests.title: This is so wong
quests.description: Eat something Asian with a fork and knife in front of Asians.

quests.title: Boopmeister
quests.description: Find a stranger or a dog and boop them on the nose twice.

quests.title: Website Helper
quests.description: Submit 3 quests on this website.

quests.title: Collector Quest
quests.description: Collect a clam, a living insect, a smooth rock, a wildflower, a bottle cap, a marble, and a safety pin. Show all of them in one picture.

quests.title: Magictime
quests.description: Learn any magic trick and perform it for someone. Cards, coins, it doesn't matter; just use a bit of sleight of hand.

quests.title: Ask 'em out, bro!
quests.description: Ask out the person you've been crushing on. You got this, mate!

quests.title: Lock Picking
quests.description: Learn to open locks without keys.

quests.title: Are We There Yet?
quests.description: Go on an overnight road trip without any devices or GPS, alone or with friends.

quests.title: Short Movie
quests.description: Spend the day creating a short movie with your friends, and at the end of the day, make some popcorn and watch it.

quests.title: MAKE BOOKS COOL AGAIN
quests.description: Buy a book (that isn't online) from the bookstore, then write a review after reading.

quests.title: Letter to Myself
quests.description: Write a letter complimenting myself and read it when I have an 'eh' day.

quests.title: Change your life in a day.
quests.description: Try burning 2,500 calories in a day.

quests.title: Animal Farm
quests.description: Figure out where the closest animal farm is to your current location and visit it!

quests.title: Color Walk
quests.description: Pick a color from a spinning wheel (online) by yourself or with friends. Explore a new area and walk around to find things with that color. The person with more pictures of their color wins!

quests.title: Strange Food
quests.description: Find a stranger, ask them what their favorite type of food is, and go eat there.

quests.title: Calisthenics Beginner
quests.description: Learn to L-sit on parallel bars.

quests.title: Operation Cooked
quests.description: Cook a full meal (main dish + side or dessert) with your friends without any adult help.

quests.title: Birthday Cinema
quests.description: Watch a movie for each year you've been alive. Expand your tastes!! (Hard rating just because it will take quite a long while.)

quests.title: A different sleepover
quests.description: Sleep in an abandoned building with a friend.

quests.title: Project: The Water Battle
quests.description: Have a water balloon battle with your friends.

quests.title: BESTSELLER
quests.description: Get with at least two friends and write a short story, a maximum of one whole sheet long (both sides), by each of you writing for five minutes and rotating until it's finished. Then go out and ask strangers to read your story and give their opinions.

quests.title: Bike ride with no end
quests.description: Go take a bike ride and go places you haven't been.

quests.title: If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.
quests.description: Enjoy the view of a big hole.
